The '''Sa'las Plains''' is a region on the [[Seanchan]] continent. No more is known about it.
{{short}}

==Notes==
It is possible that the Sa'las Plains is a reference to "plains on which battles are fought" and not an actual place on the Seanchan continent. This is based on a thought from [[Kennar Miraj]] who observes that "Mud kept down the dust, yet word of an army on the move ran like wildfire on the Sa'las Plains, whatever the land."{{ref/book|8|24}}  However, this sentence can also be read as a simple metaphor using the Sa'las Plains as the example.
